goal: Dependency injection review for hidden dependencies, global state and hard-to-test constructors.
use: Dependency injection review for hidden dependencies, global state and hard-to-test constructors. Use when code is wired through constructors or a container.

steps.note: Find the wiring. List the containers, factories and service locators.
Find hidden dependencies. Flag classes that read globals, static clocks or singletons directly.
Check lifetimes. Flag long-lived objects that hold short-lived ones.
Check testability. Flag constructors that do I/O or start threads.
Report. List each finding with file and line, the problem and the fix.
